panels.title: Candidate Minus Base Share
panels.description: Candidate operation share minus base operation share, in percentage points. Each share uses its whole run as the denominator.

options.content: Set the time range to cover both runs. The timelines show when each run generated traffic. **Inspect base** and **Inspect candidate** open the same interval in Root Cause Drilldown with the corresponding log run ID. Expand an API or dependency log entry to open its trace.
